milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the bee_nest at spawn-relative [8, 2, 6] and face toward it, modeling 'the player has found and is looking at the beehive.' max_distance=10 gives reasonable visual range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a place/build task — the player must place a flower block on the grass. Since all pre-placed flowers were removed from the scene, any poppy detected at y=0 level within the enclosure is definitively player-placed. The box covers the entire enclosure floor [-9,0,-9] to [14,0,14] with generous bounds. Checking for 'poppy' since the player has 3 poppies (most abundant flower in inventory). A dandelion would also work but we check poppy as the primary expected placement.
